Class StarDustCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.StarDustCard
public class StarDustCard extends Card
Represents a Star Dust event card that penalizes players based on their ship's design. Each player loses flight days equal to the number of exposed connectors on their ship. Players are processed in reverse order of the current standings.
